rule: Use visible index-middle and ring-little interdigital valleys A/B and wrist-center W; square side=1.05*distance(A,B), center=mid(A,B)+0.65*distance(A,B)*unit normal toward W; corners parallel to AB; no score feedback, no retry or alternate ROI. Missing landmark => unavailable, retained as failure.
orientation_rule: Square position/scale from anatomy; preserve original ROI corner orientation/chirality via nearest centered normalized corner ordering, without matcher scores. This oracle does not correct a possible 90/180 degree orientation error.
selection: Four frozen wrong queries and lexicographically first correct query in each original device case. Each true/competing identity uses its first protocol enrollment frame only. Mechanism diagnostic, not full gallery accuracy.
warning: One first enrollment frame per target, not whole gallery accuracy; manual position/scale oracle, score-independent annotation after earlier development exposure.
